name: 40324 · Georgetown, KY
findings: ZIP 40324 (Georgetown) has 182 nonprofit organizations. 70 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 51 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 40324 (Georgetown) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 40324 (Georgetown) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.
